name: ARE 5480
title: Effective Teaching Strategies and Course Design in Applied Economics
description: Introduction to course development and strategies for effective teaching. Students will be expected to attend teaching workshops, meet weekly with the instructor and their peers to discuss teaching-related topics, and work on developing their course materials including syllabi, course learning goals, lectures, and assessments. May be repeated for a total of 3 credits.
requirement_description: Open only to graduate students, instructor’s consent is required.
